newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open firmer, electronics lead gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open firmer, electronics lead gains.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly higher on Friday, as the yen's retreat against the dollar buoyed market sentiment, dealers said.
Shares of electronics companies led the gains, backed by the lower yen and recent solid earnings reports, brokers said.
At 0009 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was up 35.70 points, or 0.17 percent, at 20,543.55. September Nikkei futures gained 80 points to trade at 20,520.
Shares of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd slipped, hurt by a newspaper report concerning past Yamaichi deals.
